mandatoryCriteria: Workspace project list scoping: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects returns all workspace projects for owner, but strictly granted active projects for members
Cross-workspace project listing: GET /api/v1/projects returns all projects accessible to the authenticated actor across workspaces with role annotation
Sibling project privacy: Outsiders receive 404 NOT_FOUND when requesting project lists for ungranted workspaces
Keyset cursor pagination: List endpoints support deterministic cursor-based pagination (ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC) with bounded page sizes (default 50, max 100)
No metadata leakage: Hidden or inaccessible projects leak no name, count, or existence in list results
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects and GET /api/v1/projects endpoints, keyset pagination, role scoping, and sibling privacy on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Full-text search and client-side filtering are out-of-scope.
